run_hitl_main: run the HITL main entry point with an app config to launch a headed or headless Habitat simulation
run_hitl_headed_main: run the headed HITL main function to launch a GUI application with GLFW window and renderer
run_hitl_headless_main: run the headless HITL main function to execute a simulation loop without a GUI window
review_headless_app_loop: review the headless application loop that handles simulation updates, video recording, and frequency limiting
review_parse_debug_third_person: review the debug third person viewport parser that calculates width and height from config
